title: Core and valence
hints: Add s and p counts in that shell.

solution: $\ce{Se}$ has $4s^24p^4$ in the outer shell, for six valence electrons.
statement:
How many valence electrons does selenium have in the main-group counting convention?

[_]{a}

explanations: The filled 3d is not in the main-group outer shell.
